notes: Pure-Python EMA, SMA, RSI, Bollinger, MACD, ATR, Supertrend and Donchian implementations are inspectable at the pinned commit.
They are useful as independent formula references but do not replace Crypto Autopilot canonical technical-feature definitions.
Screeners and multi-timeframe summaries can complement discovery research.
Runtime depends on external public providers and includes retry, cache and stale-while-error behavior.
Any future captured result must preserve provider/source, venue, timeframe, observed_at, available_at and freshness/staleness.
The engine includes nine strategy examples, transaction-cost parameters, mark-to-market drawdown metrics and walk-forward analysis.
OHLCV is fetched from Yahoo Finance and is not equivalent to the project's canonical Binance/Pionex research data.

Strategy signals commonly use bar i data and record execution at bar i close, which requires an explicit market-on-close assumption and is not automatically compatible with the project's causal execution rules.
Generic fixed commission/slippage does not reproduce project funding, exchange constraints, fill lifecycle or venue-specific execution semantics.
The project emits BUY/SELL/HOLD-style labels, ratings, strategy rankings and walk-forward verdict labels.
multi_agent_service describes its final decision as a threshold artifact rather than a probability.
These outputs must not select strategies, alter project thresholds, promote models or authorize portfolio/execution actions.
The project is not an official TradingView data API and does not use the user's TradingView account.
Provider data can differ in venue, bar construction, adjustment rules, timing and cache age.
No TradingView/Yahoo/public-provider output becomes canonical project market authority from this evaluation.

overall_decision.recommended_next_step: Keep the candidate as a static/reference challenger. Do not duplicate existing Crypto Autopilot indicator and validation layers; only introduce a future adapter if a concrete diagnostic gap justifies the external network dependency.
